note: The STAND of each gym junior: where it stands and how it behaves standing there. The roster (who it is, its Normal and Challenge teams, its lines) is data/trainers.json, generated from docs/story/TRAINER_RULES.json gym_trainers. tools/route_trainers.py reads both halves like any seat file (eye contact, the rematch hold-off, the per-player defeat field) and tools/reapply.py R17 summons each one. Counts follow docs/mechanics/GYM_INTERIORS.md section 4: 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4. What every seat proves, and what it does not, is docs/world-building/GYM_TRAINERS.md.

gym2.arrival_why: Misty's hall stands on the donor template's own island, which floats: its edges hold solid only from about y118 to y128 and the island's path ends at its south lip at y128, twenty blocks over the lot's ground at y104-108 (COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31 misty.nbt, read by tools/gym_trainers.py). A walker on the ground cannot reach the door at all, so a player arrives by air, and the proof lets a player set down anywhere open to the sky.

assume_closed.why: the gym 2 well (data/gym_interiors.json gym2 rooms.shaft, scaffolding x1620 z2867 y92-133) passes through open air under the island between y108 and y114, where the island's underside is above the ground, so its scaffolding stands exposed to the lot and a walker climbs it straight into Misty's hall through the healer's cell. These are the open cells beside the column at those heights. The proof runs with them closed and the report says what each cut is worth while they are open.
